problem.paragraph: Explain exactly what is meant by the statement that “differentiation and integration are inverse processes.”

solution.paragraph: One process undoes what the other one does. See the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus.

problem.paragraph: The Sine Integral Function The sine integral function

is important in electrical engineering. [The integrand $$f(t) = \left( {\sin t} \right) \slash t$$ is not defined when $$t = 0$$ , but we know that its limit is $$1$$ when $$\left. t\rightarrow 0 \right.$$ . So we define $$f(0) = 1$$ and this makes $$f$$ a continuous function everywhere.]

problem.paragraph: A manufacturing company owns a major piece of equipment that depreciates at the (continuous) rate $$f(t)$$ , where $$t$$ is the time measured in months since its last overhaul. Because a fixed cost $$A$$ is incurred each time the machine is overhauled, the company wants to determine the optimal time $$T$$ (in months) between overhauls.

list.item: Explain why $$\int_{0}^{t}f(s)\mathit{ds}$$ represents the loss in value of the machine over the period of time $$t$$ since the last overhaul.
Let $$C = C(t)$$ be given by $$C(t) = \frac{1}{t}\left\lbrack {A + {\int_{0}^{t}f}(s)\mathit{ds}} \right\rbrack$$ What does $$C$$ represent and why would the company want to minimize $$C$$ ?
Show that $$C$$ has a minimum value at the numbers $$t = T$$ where $$C(T) = f(T)$$ .

solution.paragraph: Average expenditure over $$\left\lbrack {0,t} \right\rbrack$$ ; to minimize average expenditure
